reason: The copied collagen instructions appear to belong with the repair cell's protein-making machinery.
expectation: The instructions will engage the machinery to begin making collagen.

effect: The collagen RNA is now threaded through ribosomes, so the builders appear ready for amino acids.
reaction: The close-up makes the link between instructions and protein builders clear.
reason: Amino acids are the building blocks the directed protein builders need.
expectation: The ribosomes will join amino acids into collagen protein chains.

effect: The ribosomes have joined amino acids into new collagen chains inside membrane spaces; the chains appear ready for processing and export.
reaction: The linked amino acids make the construction clear.
reason: The processing and export membranes appear to be the next step in getting the new collagen out of the cell.
expectation: The collagen chains will be processed and exported from the repair cell.

effect: The collagen has been processed and exported, forming supporting fibers outside the cell. They appear ready to fill the damaged area.
reaction: The three panels clearly connect work inside the cell to support outside it.
reason: The wound needs supporting material, and the new fibers appear suited to that gap.
expectation: The new fibers will help replace support beneath the damaged skin.

effect: The new fibers span the deeper gap, but the surface cells still need to meet.
reaction: The cross-section makes the remaining gap clear.
reason: The cells at the scrape’s edge appear positioned to close the surface gap.

choice.combine: Skin cells at the scrape’s edge

expectation: The edge cells will help restore the surface over the rebuilt support.

effect: The edge cells first needed local repair signals; they are now dividing and spreading toward the gap.
reaction: The signals explain a step I had overlooked.
reason: The spreading surface cells appear ready to close the gap in the rebuilding body.
expectation: The cells will cover the gap and restore the protective surface.

effect: The spreading cells closed the surface gap, while the deeper collagen still needs remodeling. Both chapter goals are complete.
reaction: The earlier and later sections make the distinction between closure and ongoing repair clear.

mostWorthwhile.text: Processing and exporting the collagen was most worthwhile because the three panels connected protein production inside a cell to supporting fibers outside it.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the amino acids felt straightforward after the RNA was paired with the ribosomes, though the resulting picture made the protein chain clear.

surprise.text: I had overlooked the local repair signals needed before the surface cells could spread. The compatibility feedback revealed that step.

arbitrary.text: The repair signals were plausible, but their required use was not obvious to me before the attempted combination. The feedback made their role clearer.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: seeing cell work produce support and then a renewed surface gave the combinations a clear purpose. I would be interested to see another process connected across scales.
